# 7.4 Greedy II: priority-queue greedy, regret greedy

Phase 7 (Integration), target rating 2000–2400. Bank status: not started.

## Patterns

### Choose, then drop the worst (`deadline-heap`)

Take items in order of deadline or time and keep a heap of chosen ones, dropping the worst whenever a limit is exceeded.

**Works because:** Removing the worst chosen item always restores feasibility at the smallest possible loss.

### Undoable choices (`regret`)

Take the best option now but insert an "undo" item (with the opposite value) so that a later, better decision can reverse it.

**Works because:** Every reversal corresponds to a valid change of the solution, so the heap explores all improving exchanges.

### Merge the two smallest (`merge-smallest`)

Repeatedly combine the two smallest items (merging piles, optimal prefix codes).

**Works because:** An optimal merge tree exists in which the two smallest items are siblings at the deepest level.

### Sweep plus heap of available items (`sweep-with-heap`)

Sweep through time or values, add items as they become available, and take the best available item from a heap.

**Works because:** Items become available in sorted order, and the best available item can be taken without hurting the future.
